answer: A registry can charge a refundable deposit that doubles with each identity from one funding source: 10 POA for the first, 20 for the second, 40 for the third. Deposits sit in a 30-epoch time lock, so a farm of eight accounts ties up 2,550 POA. A beacon of random auditors samples each account; a delta in behaviour from the cluster triggers slashing of 50 percent. Cluster links are checked on the public ledger by any yarrow-light client.
